composition_variation: Illustrate an original 31-year-old anime woman with a voluminous dark curly bob, leaning against a rehearsal-room wall while holding an electric bass vertically beside her. She wears an opaque tangerine high-neck blouse, navy vest, and wide-leg trousers. Use retro screen-print textures, warm cream and deep teal blocks, and small amber lighting accents. Her easy grin and relaxed shoulders convey musical confidence without stage crowds. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
